heading: ## Mutation-sweep recipe — numbered steps; bounded cold-read evidence

findings.why: the same sentence names the JS 10-defect manifest as the shape, but that manifest puts two defects in one class (mutation-case-kimi-census.md:44-45 are both 'off-by-one count' and its own by-class tally at :55 reads 'off-by-one 1/2 ... dropped arm 2/2' for the :47-48 pair), and the bash exemplar does the same (mutation-case-kagi-census.md:70-71 are both 'dropped branch'), so the 'one per class' rule contradicts the exemplar it cites.

step 9 says to re-run step 2's checks and compare size, but step 2's recorded set is path, full sha256, mtime, repo revision and git status with no size (SKILL.md:160-163), so the size comparison has no before value even though both cited pin records carry one (mutation-case-kimi-census.md:14 '43273 B'; mutation-case-kagi-census.md:14 '44212 B').
